purpose: Measure candidate-pool coverage and maximum recoverable exact-match Recall under unconstrained and active family-aware ranking constraints.
classification: post-hoc diagnostic; does not select or modify the active method

definitions.candidate_pool_coverage: fraction of exact ground-truth relation identities present anywhere in the fixed candidate pool
definitions.unconstrained_oracle: select up to K candidate-pool ground-truth relations per context without preserving source family slots
definitions.family_slot_oracle: preserve the source top-K family counts; choose the maximum number of candidate-pool ground-truth relations inside each family
definitions.active_route_oracle: preserve source top-K family counts and the selected support/contact subsequence; proximity and vertical-order slots are filled optimally

evaluation_scope: Oracle Recall is an upper bound for fixed-candidate re-ranking under the stated constraints, not attainable model performance and not evidence about missing relation generation outside the candidate pool.
